timer_gate.nonzero_path: returns immediately when decremented $16 is nonzero
timer_gate.expired_negative_script: reads a word through local $18 indexed by local $1A >> 1

negative_script_path.word_handling: keeps the fetched word in X; if its high byte is zero, clears bit $8000 in local $18; then passes the low byte to CODE_84:E68F via CODE_84:E651

limitations: The meanings of local $16, $18, and $1A are not promoted beyond their observed timer/script roles.
A zero result is control-flow evidence only; it is not labeled animation completion without runtime correlation.
The descriptor/action reached from CODE_84:E68F remains a separate OAM/VRAM evidence task.
